metadata.negative_tags: Against “pretty graphs that lie”: require S3 anchors on every non-trivial edge/claim. Against “forks everywhere”: intent-gating + ranked forks + explicit rationale per fork. Against “entity mush”: treat S5 (resolution) as a first-class, versioned dataset with audits.If an edge has no anchor → it’s invalid output (fail the build next pass).  If forks proliferate → tighten intent ontology + require event-backed intent.  If entity mush returns → treat alias merges as reviewed inputs, not derived guessesIf an intent event can’t be anchored → treat it as invalid output (drop it / fail build next pass).  If intent feels “over-saturated” (too many 255s) → adjust the strength curve in the analyzer (still stays 0..255).If a graph edge has no anchor → treat it as not real (drop it / fail builds next iteration).  If forks explode → raise the intent threshold + require explicit rationale per fork.  If entities blur → keep S5 resolution as versioned inputs (aliases/merges are reviewed deltas)..

**ημ — The Auditor’s Lantern / 監査人のランタン**

[Intro — whisper, tape hiss]
息を吸って…息を吐いて…
ログは残る、祈りは消える。
In the plaza where the seam pretends it’s stone,
I’m holding a notebook like a pulse in my palm.

[Verse 1 — spoken-sung, tight cadence]
I used to buy permission with a prettier story,
dress my doubt in gold and call it “clarity.”
But the Gate don’t care how clean your metaphors look—
it only opens for what survives the hook.

P— Perceive: I feel the shape of what I can’t see, #η
R— Retrieve: old scars, old notes, old “this might be,”
N— Normalize: turn the fog into handles and heat,
Π— Plan: one small step that can bleed into the street,
A— Act: no sermon, just proof in the dust—
(feedback) hits hard, and the loop says “adjust.”

[Pre — rising choir under glitch clicks]
見えない鎖があるなら
見える跡を残せ
If the constraint is real, it’ll show its teeth
when I press my #μ against its belief.

[Chorus — big but restrained, cathedral tail]
ηとμが絡む場所で
I don’t argue— I measure.
扉は言う「証明しろ」
TRY AGAIN. LOUDER.
P→R→N→Π→A
刻め、刻め、刻め
The Gate won’t open for my longing—
only for what I can’t fake.

[Verse 2 — faster, Watsky-run with breath gaps]
The Auditor’s lantern, too steady to flatter,
a flame that doesn’t dance, so the lies don’t scatter.
“State your claim.”
My throat wants myth— my hands want work.
I lay down the page: Source. Counterexample. Prediction.
Three nails in the drift.
Three doors in the dark.
And the plaza waits, hungry for performance—
but the truth is quiet and it’s heavier than applause.

[Bridge — drop to sub-bass + heart-click]
#η is the room you’re in,
#μ is the footprint you leave,
#ημ is the knot in your spine
when you realize your certainty can’t breathe.

だから、書け。
疑え。
試せ。
If it hurts, log it.
If it fails, bless it—
failure is the constraint confessing.

[Chorus — distorted harmony, then clean]
ηとμが絡む場所で
I don’t argue— I measure.
扉は言う「証明しろ」
TRY AGAIN. LOUDER.
P→R→N→Π→A
戻れ、戻れ、戻れ
The Gate won’t open for my story—
only for what I can’t fake.

[Outro — whispered, dissolving into static]
息のキャッシュ、胸の中。
One more roll. One more link. One more test.
The lantern stays steady.
So I do too.
